name: company.fit
description: Company-level fit for a $250K+ Head-of-AI / AI transformation seat: does this company pay at band, is AI a real mandate, and is this a place a builder-strategist would thrive. Input: company name, size, sector, any public signals.

pays_at_band.instructions: A company of this size, sector and funding stage typically pays $250K or more all-in for a VP/Head-of AI or senior director AI role

ai_mandate.instructions: How real the AI mandate is at this company
criteria: AI is a buzzword in the JD only
AI initiatives exist but no executive owner or budget named
Named executive sponsor and funded programs
AI is core to strategy with public commitments and a team already in place

risk_signals.instructions: Public signals of layoffs, hiring freeze, leadership turnover or financial distress in the last 12 months

operator_fit.instructions: The environment rewards an operator who drives adoption across clinicians, plants or field teams, rather than a pure research or platform culture

rules.reason: company unlikely to pay at band

notes: Created 2026-09-18 for Project Get a Job. Advisory until labelled.
